_about: Crop boxes for tools/images.py all. crop = x,y,w,h in source pixels (4:5 for portraits; any shape for scenes, the photos of the club at work). frac crops are fractions of the image and survive a higher-resolution source.

hero.ceiling_note: Fraction of the photo's height, from the top, that is only ceiling (the highest head starts at about 0.215). Wide screens may crop this much and no more; anything wider gets margins. Re-measure if the photo changes.

portraits.note: from his SynBioBeta 2026 speaker page; the source is 300 × 400, so ask him for a larger photo he is happy for the club to use. Eyes at about 36%, head about 55%.

The club’s own photo from his visit (Oct 29, 2026), in front of the Dartmouth backdrop; cropped to him alone. Eyes at about 40%, head about 57% of the frame. The original is 8064 × 4536, so the crop has room to spare.

scenes.note: The club's own photo of Nicholas Larus-Stone's talk by video (Nov 10, 2026), as sent in chat (2000 × 1125): the original from the phone would be sharper on large screens. Crop: 2:1, without the ceiling, the door and the empty chairs on the right. neutral is the white wall right of the lectern: the room light is yellow, and 80% of that cast is taken out.
